terminology.not_annotated_by_source: observable and evaluated, but the source reports no annotation; not a confirmed biological absence
terminology.source_unavailable: observable nucleotide but the source returned no record for this instance/entity

junction_loops_union.rule: set union of all junction loop types present (J3, J4); never the sum of the per-type counts

ligand_binding_sites.by_ccd_entries: per bound ccd in contact at the position, counted per PDB entry: n_positive_observable_and_evaluated / n_observable_and_evaluated = entries with a recorded contact / entries with the bound ccd that have an observed nucleotide here in a chain of a source-evaluated entity; n_not_observable entries (no observed nucleotide in any chain) and n_source_unavailable entries are not counted as negatives. An observed-contact frequency among coordinate-observable entries, not a binding probability

junction_loops_union.rule: set union of J3, J4 loops/instances/entries (not a sum)
